C0044.title: Douyin Cracks Down on "Main–Alt Account" Matrix Cheating
C0044.summary: Douyin officially released the "Douyin Matrix Account Misconduct Governance Rules," explicitly targeting the use of group-control tools, illegal scripts, and other technical means to operate multiple accounts for posting violative low-quality content, inflating followers/likes/comments, and fabricating engagement data.
